title: pouteria boliviana
intro: Pouteria boliviana, commonly known as the Bolivian tree or Andiroba tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria boliviana include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiparasitic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include andiroba oil, which contains fatty acids, and other compounds such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contributing to its medicinal properties.
